meta.title: The Power Playground
meta.story: The festival crew has found a chest of extraordinary balls. Learn seven powers, combine them, and bring the grand parade to life. Hit a charge peg to power your next shot; the controls stay the same.

chapters.title: Discover the Powers
chapters.story: Explore the festival grounds and learn how to aim each extraordinary ball.

chapters.title: Make a Combination
chapters.story: Bring your powers together for the grand parade.

finale.title: A Parade of Possibilities
finale.story: Ghost trails, bright sparks, and a chorus of bouncing balls light the festival sky. You learned every power and made the parade your own.

levels.title: The Charge Gate
levels.story: Aim for a pale ghost charge peg first. Its power waits for your next shot. Then line up the targets behind the blue pegs: your ghost ball can collect straight through them.

levels.title: Fan Out
levels.story: Collect a Multiball charge, then choose a route between the sun pegs. Your next shot launches a spreading fan of three balls. A spare charge stays ready for another turn.

levels.title: Starburst Orchard
levels.story: The orchard lights grow in tight clusters. Charge a Blast ball, then aim its first hit into the busiest group. Nearby charge pegs bank their powers even when a burst collects them.

levels.title: Ember Lanes
levels.story: Follow the long lanes of ember lights. Fireball goes through pegs and warms up their neighbors. Look for a route that runs along a whole lane, rather than across one peg.

levels.title: Second Wind
levels.story: The lights make a loop beneath the northern sky. An Echo ball returns from the bottom once for another pass. Try a wide shot: a ball that misses the plate can still come back.

levels.title: Magnetic Harbor
levels.story: The harbor plate is narrow, but a Magnet ball pulls falling balls toward it. Collect a charge above the docks, then time a shot toward the moving plate to keep your supply going.

levels.title: Read the Ricochet
levels.story: Stone bumpers open new bank shots. Charge Super guide to see several bounces before you launch. Stone always stays solid, even for Ghost ball and Fireball.

levels.title: Ghosts and Sparks
levels.story: Two kinds of charge pegs wait in the forest. Different powers combine on your next shot: Ghost ball can carry a Blast ball burst into a hidden cluster. Two charges of the same kind last two turns.

levels.title: Three Returns
levels.story: Bring an invitation to every island. Pair Multiball with Echo ball and each of your three balls gets another pass if it falls past the plate. Aim between islands to spread your coverage.

levels.title: The Furnace
levels.story: The furnace plate alternates between catching and bouncing. Pair Fireball with Magnet ball to guide the heat through the lanes and back toward the plate. Watch its symbol before you launch.

levels.title: Combo Constellation
levels.story: Build your own constellation of powers. A long shot, a bank shot, or a chain of ten pegs earns style points. A shot scoring 2,500 points gives you an extra ball; bigger shots can earn more.

levels.title: Grand Power Parade
levels.story: Clear the entire parade board. Charge a combination, open a route through the center, and sweep the last pegs. If you earn a charge with your last ball, one charged shot is returned so you can use it.
